prompts.deck:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: finished full-screen game UI art reference for 拍案三国, deck-building screen.
Primary request: Generate ONE new polished COMPLETE interface concept image, landscape 16:10, not a bare illustration and not a collage. Reference image 1 is the approved visual style and material standard (camp); reference image 2 is the current deck page functional layout. Use both as references, not edit targets. Upgrade the artwork and visual hierarchy while keeping the page simple.
Style: nostalgic 1990s Chinese Three Kingdoms lianhuanhua / woodblock printing, expressive fine black ink portraits, cream aged paper and subtle printed grain, cinnabar vermilion seals and thin double-line borders, restrained jade and indigo, warm dark wooden school desk visible at margins. The UI itself should feel like a beautifully printed illustrated general-card album spread on the desk. Flat frontal UI, easy to read, no browser chrome.
Composition: top narrow cream header with red seal '将', large brush title '构筑 · 将牌册', smaller 'Lv.9 · 金币 4820', upper-right outlined button '← 返回大本营'. Below, a clear horizontal team row titled '上阵将牌', five substantial portrait cards with readable names: '朱灵', '文聘', '韩玄', '程普', '周仓'; faction stamp and stars;朱灵 outlined in vermilion to indicate selection, '5 / 5' small at right. They are different distinct personalities and armor, not copied identical faces. Next a thin tab row '将牌组合', '武将装备', '武将带兵' with first selected.
Lower main body has only TWO balanced areas. LEFT about 30%: beautiful LARGE selected 朱灵 portrait in a worn paper card frame (blue armored bearded commander), name '朱灵', stars, 'Lv.3', ability '三拍引雷', short text '每3次拍击，附1层雷印', two clear buttons '培养 148 金币' and '卸下'. RIGHT about 70%: top slim richly illustrated team-combination strip with a small indigo ink lightning emblem and exact headings '雷印联动' and '朱灵附雷 → 文聘重掌引爆'; optional small secondary hints '烈火' and '追击' but no long paragraphs. Beneath it '将牌仓库', small selector '全部', simple search field '找武将'. Six large attractive portrait thumbnails in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, clear readable name tags: '马良', '赵云', '张飞', '黄盖', '关羽', '甘宁'. Prioritize images and whitespace over dense stats. Small stars and muted route tags suffice; no repeated long ability text. Cards look like actual collectible paper cards, crisp portrait art, subtle wear.
Bottom full-width persistent result strip: left red square seal '整', title '宛城 · 未通关', small '收获 555 金币 · 可先整备再挑战'; right prominent cinnabar button '重新挑战' and cream outlined secondary '换地图'. All controls aligned and fully visible with generous margins.
Typography: accurate simplified Chinese, large calligraphic display headings, smaller legible ink print text. Render quoted strings verbatim, no gibberish or English paragraphs.
Constraints: match approved camp's warm paper style, human-readable restrained UI, only specified core controls; no modern dashboard, neon, glossy plastic, sci-fi ornaments, 3D-rendered generals, tiny illegible numbers, huge stats tables, clutter, watermark. Make the result a coherent complete shippable game-screen art reference with strong card art.
prompts.base:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: finished full-screen game UI art reference for 拍案三国, base-building screen.
Primary request: Generate ONE new polished COMPLETE interface concept image, landscape 16:10. Reference image 1 is the approved camp's visual/material style; reference image 2 is the current base-building functional page. Use as references, not edit targets. Make the city illustration more prominent and the controls simpler, matching the deck-building reference from the same game.
Style: nostalgic 1990s Chinese lianhuanhua / woodblock printing on subtly aged ivory paper, precise fine black line drawing, pale ochre fields, muted jade vegetation, indigo tiled roofs, cinnabar highlights, restrained double-line vermilion frames and square seals. Warm worn dark wood desk around paper margin. Frontal complete interface, beautiful hand-printed miniature city, no browser chrome.
Top narrow header: red seal '城', brush title '基建 · 城池经营', small subtitle '建筑替你攒金币', 'Lv.9 · 金币 4820', right outlined button '← 返回大本营'.
Main content has three spacious areas, separated only by thin print rules. LEFT compact 17% '城册': three paper city entries with hand-printed tiny city thumbnails, names '樊城', '中庐', '宜城';樊城 selected in vermilion, small '7 / 小时', '6 / 小时', '12 / 小时'. No long city directory.
CENTER dominant 56%: a large cinematic wide isometric hand-drawn Three Kingdoms city illustration filling most of this area: walled gate, tiled granary, timber workshop with scaffolding and planks, small drill yard with spear rack and pennants, wheat/cabbage fields, wooden cart and tiny villagers. It looks like a lovingly ink-printed pop-up town on cream paper, charming distinct structures, generous clear sky/landscape negative space on left for heading '樊城', '产出 7 / 小时'. Below illustration a short '建筑槽位 1 / 1' row and one selected little illustrated '菜地 Lv.2' paper slot. Beneath that a simple selected-building panel with vegetable field illustration, name '菜地', 'Lv.2 / 10', '产出 7 / 小时', one large cinnabar button '升级 252 金币' and small cream '拆除'. Keep this compact; no complex management charts.
RIGHT 27% cream warehouse ledger: gold-colored '全城产出 24 / 小时'; two clear tabs '建筑仓库' and '建筑合成', warehouse selected. Three or four visually generous building-card rows with distinct hand-drawn thumbnails and legible names '小卖部', '农田', '木哨塔', '水井', small star/quantity tags, consistent '建造' buttons (muted disabled at full slots). The warehouse is uncluttered, no wall of percentages, no accordion or extra nested menus.
Bottom full-width persistent result strip: left red square seal '整', title '宛城 · 未通关', small '收获 555 金币 · 可先建设再挑战'; right cinnabar primary '重新挑战', outlined secondary '换地图'. Exact text clean and legible.
Typography: accurate simplified Chinese, black brush title, readable printed body. Maintain full visible controls and comfortable margins at 16:10. A functional base-building menu inside the approved paper/wood aesthetics, not a generic city-building screenshot.
Avoid: modern dashboards, neon, overly intricate stat panels, glossy fantasy palaces, plastic mobile UI, photorealistic humans, browser/window borders, watermark, unreadable invented text.
